original_value: Vanta Bloom 34 is a fictional 34-inch curved tablet display designed for digital illustration kiosks and interactive exhibit walls. It features a USB-C input, 3440x1440 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and integrated stylus-aware touch layer for collaborative creative work. The unit is aimed at studio installations rather than gaming or general office use.
